info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Loyalty Points Tiers-v1-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Tiers API enables users to access and retrieve information about the various tiers within hotel loyalty programs. This API is particularly useful for frequent travelers and hotel management systems that need to display or analyze loyalty rewards structures. By utilizing this API, developers can effortlessly integrate tier-specific benefits and point requirements into their applications. Typical consumers may include mobile apps for travelers, booking platforms, and customer relationship management systems.

get.description: Fetches the current points tier for a user, providing details about their loyalty status and associated benefits.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the tier information for points. It should contain the required parameters to specify the desired tier details.
